Package org.smtlib.sexpr

Class Printer

java.lang.Object
org.smtlib.sexpr.Printer
All Implemented Interfaces:
IPrinter, IVisitor<Void>
Direct Known Subclasses:
Printer, Printer.WithLines, Solver_z3_4_3.Translator
public class Printer extends Object implements IPrinter, IVisitor<Void>
This class writes out SMT-LIB ASTs as concrete S-expression syntax; aside from white space between tokens it should simply reverse what the Parser class does.
